description: § 469(a)(1)(B), (d)(2): a passive activity credit is allowed only against the tax on net passive income. A passive business with a $5,000 loss and a $2,000 credit (Worksheet 4, no special allowance): Form 8582 line 3 is a loss, line 6 is zero, nothing is allowed — the $2,000 carries forward with the activity.
